admission.justification: Explicit source attribution and committed code-memory pairing together let stored knowledge and its delivered code be traced to their actual inputs; neither member alone connects authored provenance with the published pair.

guarantee: Nothing a stored record or a landing claims about its inputs is authored by the run that reports it: a code realization names a repository-relative path and the exact blob the recorded tree holds, a source that is not a repository file keeps its own document identity, and a leaf's code commit and its refreshed memory content land as one attributed pair.
title: attribution-and-landing-pairing
